<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TreeHouse" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/treehouse">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TreeHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Stores" name="Online stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" name="Requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Draft" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalRequirements" name="Additional requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect" messageRef="Msg_AdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedDraft" name="Revised draft" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft" messageRef="Msg_RevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Material order" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Participant_Stores" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Order processed" sourceRef="Participant_Stores" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDelivery" messageRef="Msg_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequest" name="Build request" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestHouseBuild" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_HouseBuilt" name="House built" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitations" name="Party invitation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Msg_Invitation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Requirements" name="Requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Draft" name="Draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AdditionalRequirements" name="Additional requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RevisedDraft" name="Revised draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Material order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Delivery" name="Order processed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuildRequest" name="Build request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_HouseBuilt" name="House built"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Invitation" name="Party invitation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a tree house" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Tree house project started"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft from architect" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DraftMerge" name="Draft merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDraft" name="Review draft"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewSplit" name="Further requirements?" default="Flow_PlanApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAdditionalRequirements" name="Send additional requirements to architect" messageRef="Msg_AdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft" name="Receive revised draft from architect" messageRef="Msg_RevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from online stores" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderSplit" name="Order processing split"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDelivery" name="Receive order processed confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RequestHouseBuild" name="Send build request to friends" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderJoin" name="Order processing join"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" name="House built">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_HouseBuilt" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendInvitations" name="Send party invitations to friends" messageRef="Msg_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of attendees"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuySnacks" name="Buy snacks for party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_End" name="Party prepared"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Gateway_DraftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_DraftMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDraft" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FurtherRequirements" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewSplit" targetRef="SendTask_SendAdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanApproved" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft" targetRef="Gateway_DraftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="SendTask_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_OrderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderSplit" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderSplit" targetRef="SendTask_RequestHouseBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDelivery" targetRef="Gateway_OrderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestHouseBuild" targetRef="Gateway_OrderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderJoin" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" targetRef="SendTask_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="Task_BuySnacks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_BuySnacks" targetRef="EndEvent_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
